summary: HCA Healthcare, Inc., via its subsidiary HCA Inc., closed a public offering of $3B aggregate principal amount of senior notes (4.700% due 2031, 5.000% due 2033, 5.300% due 2036), each guaranteed by the parent. The offering was made under an existing shelf registration statement. This is a routine debt issuance and does not represent a special situation such as an acquisition, restructuring, or other transformative event. No premiums, buybacks, or structural changes are involved. The filing merely reports entry into supplemental indentures. Investors should monitor the use of proceeds and overall leverage.
